text.p: WebSecure Inc said on Tuesday it named Tibor Vais as president and chief executive. He succeeds Robert Kuzara, who will now be primarily responsible for investor relations.
Vais will also become a director of the company. He was previously general manager of data technologies at CompuServe Corp.
Speaking to Reuters by phone, Kuzara said the move was aimed at bringing a person with a strong industry background to the company and was part of the company's initial public offering plan.
WebSecure went public in December at $8 a share. It now trades at about $14.

"I'll be focusing on bringing in some strategic mergers to position the company to where we want it to be, but my forte is not day-to-day operations," Kuzara said. He owns about three percent of WebSecure and his contract runs for three years, he said.
